full_judgment: Moreover, in C.S. operation, the suit land was recorded in the name of Railway. C.S. khatian shows that in the column of  অত্র স্বত্বের বিবরণ ও দখলকার the words ভারত সম্রাট পক্ষে ইস্ট বেঙ্গল ইস্ট রেলওয়ে in the column of ”অত্র স্বত্বের শ্রেণি বিশেষ নম্বর অনুষঙ্গ” the words  ”নারায়ণগঞ্জ ময়মনসিংহ রেলওয়ে মালিক” and against plot No. 121 “জমির রকম”  was mentioned as  রেল লাইন and the land was measuring an area of 5.54 acres. As per provision of Section 103 8(5) of the Bengal Tenancy Act every entry in a record of rights finally published shall be evidence of the matter referred to in such entry, and shall be presumed to be correct until it is proved by evidence to be incorrect. The entry in the C.S. khatian has a' probative value. The presumption under Section 1038(5) of the B.T. Act being a statutory one cannot be taken away merely by an allegation. The defendants failed to adduce any evidence to rebut such presumption.
